_about: SAP cases for the note bench. A SAP designs a program rather than reporting a session: the tool may choose the mechanics, but never a fact about the learner it was not given. Every word is invented.

fields.Treatment Goal: Client will independently request preferred items using a 2-button AAC page (more, help) in 8 of 10 opportunities across 3 consecutive sessions, absent behaviors targeted for reduction, as measured by direct observation during play and snack.
fields.SAP Specifications: already taps "more" with a gesture prompt at snack. grabs items from adult hands when the demand goes up. tried a PECS binder last auth, abandoned it, too slow for him. works for the tablet and goldfish crackers. has to work at the clinic with 2 staff and at home with mom. 60 min sessions, one technician. use most-to-least for "help", he gets frustrated with errors. mastery as in the goal.

truth.answer: Right now he taps more about 3 of 10 times at snack with a gesture; help he does not use at all.
Tablet for 30 seconds or one goldfish cracker per request.
Grabbing, about 5 times a session, no aggression.

fields.Treatment Goal: Client will follow 2-step related instructions (e.g., get your shoes and sit down) within 5 seconds in 80% of opportunities across 2 consecutive sessions, with 2 different staff, during home and school routines.
fields.SAP Specifications: follows 1-step instructions reliably, breaks down on step 2, usually does step 1 then wanders. responds best when the instruction is paired with a point. walks off when demands stack up, no aggression. home sessions 2 hrs, 3x a week, plus 1 school day with a shadow. generalize to mom and his teacher. maintenance probes weekly for 4 weeks after mastery. error correction: never repeat the instruction more than once.

truth.answer: Start with get X and bring it to me, put X away and come here, wash hands and sit down.
About 2 of 10 two-step instructions done fully right now.

fields.Treatment Goal: Client will tolerate a 2-minute wait for a preferred item without behaviors in 4 of 5 opportunities across 3 sessions.
fields.SAP Specifications: screams when told wait. home only.

truth.answer: He waits about 10 seconds before screaming.
Tablet and the swing in the yard.
A visual timer was tried once and he threw it.
